response.rationale: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease is more likely due to the presence of coagulative necrosis and karyorrhexis, which are characteristic of this condition. While Castleman disease is also a possibility, the biopsy findings are more consistent with Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease.

rejected.why: Normal laboratory studies and lack of systemic symptoms make Sarcoidosis less likely
Rosai-Dorfman disease is less likely due to the presence of coagulative necrosis and karyorrhexis, which are not typical of this condition
